aaa_enabled.summary: Configure AAA authentication profiles and assign to admin roles.
aaa_enabled.notes: Always verify local admin fallback before enabling AAA.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable insecure telnet and HTTP services on the management interface.
cli: set deviceconfig system service disable-telnet yes
set deviceconfig system service disable-http yes
secure_vty_transport.notes: Ensures SSH and HTTPS are the only allowed protocols.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Configure the management login idle timeout to 10 minutes (600 seconds) or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Login timeout is configured in minutes in PAN-OS.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Configure password complexity settings to ensure secure password hashing.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: PAN-OS hashes passwords by default; complexity settings enforce strong passwords.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default or insecure SNMP community strings.
cli: delete deviceconfig system snmp-setting v2c community public

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the unencrypted HTTP management interface.
cli: set deviceconfig system service disable-http yes
http_server_disabled.notes: Ensures that all web administrative sessions use HTTPS.

ssh_version_2.summary: Ensure weak SSH cryptographic algorithms are disabled.
cli: set deviceconfig system ssh profiles default
ssh_version_2.notes: SSH v2 is enabled by default in PAN-OS.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure a remote syslog server profile.
cli: set shared log-settings syslog syslog-1 server 10.0.0.1
logging_enabled.notes: Ensure that events and logs are forwarded to a central log server.

management_acl.summary: Restrict management access to permitted IP addresses.
management_acl.notes: Configure permitted IP lists under system settings.

cli: set deviceconfig system login-banner "Authorized Access Only!"
login_banner.notes: Legal warning banner displayed before login.

password_min_length.summary: Enforce a minimum password length of 12 characters.
password_min_length.notes: Enforces minimum length constraints for local admin passwords.

ntp_configured.summary: Configure redundant NTP servers for time synchronization.
cli: set deviceconfig system ntp-servers primary-ntp ntp-server-address 1.1.1.1
set deviceconfig system ntp-servers secondary-ntp ntp-server-address 2.2.2.2
ntp_configured.notes: Time synchronization is critical for audit log correlation.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Configure SNMP community strings as read-only.
cli: set deviceconfig system snmp-setting v2c community secure-ro-string
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Avoid read-write community strings in v1/v2c SNMP.
